author: Inside Edition
description: Former US Senator Kyrsten Sinema is facing accusations that she had an affair with her married bodyguard, 39-year-old Matthew Ammel. Ammel's estranged wife is suing Sinema for alienation of affection under the so-called Homewrecker Law. The wife's attorney tells Inside Edition that Sinema "enticed Mr. Ammel with lavish trips, concerts and exorbitant salary and psychedelic drugs."  The bodyguard and wife have three children. Sinema did not respond to Inside Edition's request for comment.
title: Lawsuit Accuses Former Senator Of Having Affair With Married Bodyguard

author: Inside Edition
description: Many people are nostalgic for 2016. Social media challenges, skinny jeans and the water bottle flip were all the rage. Ever since New Year's Day 2026, the hashtag "2016" has surged 450 percent. On TikTok, which did not exist a decade ago, there have been 1.7 million posts about 2016. Celebrities are also taking part by posting throwback photos like Selena Gomez, Kylie Jenner and Reese Witherspoon. Eva Longoria posted a video with once popular animal face filters.
title: All Over Social Media, It's The Year 2016

author: Inside Edition
description: A brazen smash and grab robbery at a game store in New York City was all caught on camera. Three robbers burst into the store in downtown Manhattan, and took all the Pokemon cards. They were worth $100,000. This is the latest crime spree tied to Pokemon cards. In Massachusetts, surveillance cameras caught a thief making off with a haul worth over $100,000. In California, thieves broke through the roof then ceiling, but the valuable cards were kept hidden in a safe.
title: Thieves Caught On Camera Stealing $100K Worth Of Pokemon Cards

author: Inside Edition
description:
Ashley St. Clair, mother to one of Elon Musk’s children, speaks out against X’s Ai chatbot Grok after sexually suggestive images were produced by users and publicly distributed of her - without her permission. St. Clair is going straight to Grok to report these deepfake images rather than Elon himself to mirror the process that any user can take if it happens to them.

In a sit down interview with Inside Edition’s Eva Pilgrim, St. Clair says that Musk is aware of what is going on and has ignored the problem, “Oh he’s very involved, that’s why I know that  this can all be stopped with a singular message to an engineer, because I’ve watched him bother those engineers for a whole lot less.”

Despite a statement from the @safety account on X posted Wednesday evening, “We have implemented technological measures to prevent the [@]Grok account on X globally from allowing the editing of images of real people in revealing clothing such as bikinis. This restriction applies to all users, includi
title: EXTENDED CUT: Eva Pilgrim’s sit-down with Ashley St. Clair

author: Inside Edition
description: Colin Swift, father of an alleged victim of actor Timothy Busfield, tells Inside Edition Busfield attacked his daughter in 2001 when she was a 16-year-old intern at a theatre founded by the actor. Swift says he confronted Busfield at the time for aggressively touching his daughter. Busfield's attorney says Swift's allegations about his daughter "were never proved." Busfield has not been charged in connection with Swift's allegation and denies the charges in his criminal case involving allegations made by two boys.
title: Father Of Alleged Timothy Busfield Victim Speaks Out

author: Inside Edition
description: A blaze erupted at Zoo World in Panama City Beach, Florida. Zoo World is a popular attraction in the city featuring lions, camels, flamingos and other exotic animals. As one sheriff's deputy ran to his car to retrieve equipment, he encountered worried zoo workers. To save the animals, authorities had to force their way into animal enclosures. Six lemurs were lost in the fire. In a statement, the zoo says the disaster is beyond sad and that they vow to honor the lemurs by rebuilding.
title: 6 Lemurs Lost In Florida Zoo Fire

author: Inside Edition
description: It was a race against an oncoming train after a man fell onto the tracks moments before its arrival. Cambridge Police in Massachusetts released bodycam video of the rescue. Officials say the man was injured and couldn't get off the tracks by himself. When the officer arrived he met up with another officer and they both jumped onto the tracks to get the man. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cops Rescue Man Who Fell On Tracks 1 Minute Before Train's Arrival

author: Inside Edition
description: Farmers in France made a statement with a massive food giveaway. Potato farmers reportedly dumped 30 tons of spuds outside the National Assembly in Paris to protest an unpopular trade deal. Trade unions say the EU-Mercosur trade deal will hurt European farmers by giving an advantage to competition in South America. French farmers say the potato could just disappear in France if they can't afford to keep producing it. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Farmers Dump 30 Tons Of Potatoes In Paris To Protest Proposed Trade Deal

title: ICE Agent Shoots Minneapolis Man In Leg #shorts
